note: Ports of the Reach (S3.4, D-114; named in S3.5, D-118; brief §11, §12). Each port point on the chart is given one of these at the start of a run, from the `market` dice, and shows its name. `faction` is who runs it. Prices are in credits: `fuel` a unit, `hull` a point mended, `system` a bar of system damage mended, `salvage` what the yard pays for a crate that is nobody's contract. `services` lists what it offers (refuel, repair, sell, hire); every port sells fuel. Markets, dockmasters and port memory arrive in Stage 7.

items.name: Kessel Port
items.text: The old company's regional office, still lit, still staffed, still stamping forms for a company that is gone. The fuel is clean and the clerks are slow.

items.name: Tallow Yard
items.text: A breaker's yard bolted to an ore rock. Everything here was a ship once, and the yard boss can tell you which.

items.name: Candlewick
items.text: A dim station of the Quiet Order. The docking lights are candles behind glass. The fuel is sold without a word, and the price is written on a slate.

items.name: Free Berth
items.text: A Confederation anchorage of hulls lashed together. There is a copy of the code nailed up at every lock, and a gun at every copy.

items.name: White Lantern
items.text: A Cooperative clinic station, painfully clean. A nurse checks the crew for fever before anyone is allowed off the ship.

items.name: Pell Station
items.text: A union refinery with a dock on the side. The air tastes of sulphur and the canteen is open all hours.

items.name: Ashgrove
items.text: A hydroponics station run by the union's widows' fund. They sell fuel to pay for seed, and they will tell you so.

items.name: Registry Nine
items.text: A Receivers records depot. Every ship that docks is photographed, weighed and logged, and then helped very efficiently.

items.name: Gallows Reach
items.text: A Confederation court station. Disputes over shares are heard here on the first of every month, and the docking fee is waived for witnesses.

items.name: Stillwater
items.text: A hermitage with a fuel line. The brothers who run it have taken a vow about speaking, and a separate, looser vow about prices.

items.name: Copper Hollow
items.text: A worked-out mine with a dock in the old shaft head. The miners stayed when the copper did not.

items.name: Lowry Moorings
items.text: Lowry & Sons' salvage moorings. Old Lowry is dead and the sons do not agree about anything, including the price of fuel.

items.name: Halcyon Dock
items.text: The company's old executive dock, with carpets. The carpets are worn through at the airlock where people have stood waiting to be told no.

items.name: The Shambles
items.text: A market built inside a dead bulk carrier. You can buy anything here once, and nothing twice from the same stall.

items.name: Mercy Seven
items.text: A Cooperative research platform with a public dock and a private one. The public one is very welcoming.

items.name: Drover Point
items.text: A tug station where the union keeps its rescue boats. They will tow you in for free and charge you for everything after that.

items.name: Vigil
items.text: An Order watch post on the edge of the dark. They keep a list of ships that went past and did not come back, and they ask your name.

items.name: Sallow Quay
items.text: A Receivers customs quay, mostly empty. The duty officer is pleased to see anyone at all, which is worse.
